directives.title: Strict Prohibition of Battery Transit via Passenger Train Cargo
points: Absolute Ban on Rail Luggage for Batteries: Following multiple RPF challans and legal notices issued for transporting hazardous lead-acid batteries in passenger rail compartments, all staff are strictly forbidden from booking batteries as train luggage.

Dedicated Road Carriers Only: Traction batteries and heavy chemical battery packs must exclusively move through registered surface logistics, commercial cargo trucks, or certified express couriers with valid e-way bills and hazmat declarations.
General Hardware Rail Dispatch: Non-hazardous spare parts, cards, cables, and lightweight motors may continue to utilize train cargo when accompanied by formal transit receipts.

directives.title: Interim Battery Swapping & Fleet Cannibalization Protocol
points: Consolidate Functional Batteries: When multiple machines are partially crippled with 1 to 4 bad battery cells at a single location (e.g. Sanand), technicians must systematically test and consolidate good batteries into designated priority machines.
Maximize Operational Uptime: Ensure at least 60–70% of the fleet remains 100% operational rather than having 100% of machines stalled in degraded status awaiting new batteries.
Mandatory Dossier Prerequisite: Cannibalization does not waive reporting; specific gravity sheets and serial numbers of swapped batteries must be recorded in the Breakdown group.

directives.title: Loss-Rental & High-Value Spare Procurement Escalation Protocol
points: Stop Inter-Departmental Delays: Any procurement requisition pending for more than 48 hours due to loss-rental costing or ownership ambiguities must be immediately escalated to a direct three-way conference call with Vishal Sir and Dhrup Sir.
Fast-Track Commercial Approvals: Once costing is established, formal PO approval must be closed within the same working day to avoid grounded machines exceeding 7 days of downtime.

directives.title: OEM Portal Complaint Logging Prerequisite
points: Mandatory OEM Portal Registration: Field supervisors coordinating OEM field service (e.g. Zoomlion, JCB) must lodge complaints directly on the OEM's customer support portal with serial numbers and machine hours before requesting deputation.
Direct Service Tracking: Log ticket reference IDs in the daily breakdown update so management can track OEM engineer SLAs.
